comment: The comparison grammar. DEFEND THE SIZE OF THIS FILE. If it ever needs expressions, a second verifier stops being cheap and the platform-neutral half of the conformance suite becomes unspecifiable. Pressure to add an expression is evidence a requirement is written at the wrong level.

present.holds_when: the observed value exists and is non-empty

equals.holds_when: the observed value equals the argument

one_of.holds_when: the observed value is a member of the argument

contains.holds_when: the observed collection includes the argument

min.holds_when: the observed number is >= the argument

max.holds_when: the observed number is <= the argument

order.holds_when: the observed sequence equals the argument

absent_from.holds_when: the element contributes nothing to the named observation

source.holds_when: the named zone is what supplied the observed value
